verdict.rationale: Jan has a public documentation site, so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. Probes found no such artifact: llms.txt, docs.md and OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The human-readable API reference with curl examples is ordinary documentation, not an agent-oriented docs format, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
